_comment: Surface-marker MANO fit for P1. Same settings as P10.json/P12.json; see P10.json for why each one.
MARKER SET: 19 markers. Forearm3, Forearm4 and Palm3 are never present in any trial. Anything
needing Palm3 does not apply; angles_from_markers seeds from Palm2 only (commit 9fa30a3).
STATIC: P1 has no static recording. The static is a still stretch of Trial 1 hands only (P101, frames 13700-13900),
and saved as results/soma/labels/P1/static/soma_labelled.csv. It is the stretch the labeller was calibrated on.
REUSED FROM P10, NOT MEASURED ON THIS PARTICIPANT:
- attach_file: configs/surface_fit/P1P2_attach.json = P10_attach.json minus Palm1 (the palm
markers sit elsewhere on P1/P2; Palm1 is left to the automatic surface search). Finger entries kept.
- stretch_file: P10's flexion-dependent skin slide. Slopes are approximate for another hand.
STATIC-STAGE RESULT (--staged, 400/400 iters, 5 ICP rounds): stage 1 joint-centre MEAN |d| 7.50 mm;
stage 2 surface-point-to-marker MEAN |d| 4.25 mm. Largest per-marker: Thumb2 9.3, Pinky1 7.6, Ring1 6.3 (others <=5.7).
